telemetry.privacy.lede: What wisp sends about itself (never prompts, paths or code), and what it asks before a repo's own programs run.
telemetry.privacy.stats.title: Anonymous usage stats
telemetry.privacy.stats.what: Agent, model, status, timings and scrubbed errors only.
telemetry.privacy.trust.title: Ask before a repo’s hooks, servers and setup run
telemetry.privacy.trust.description: Claude Code runs a repo’s hooks and MCP servers, and wisp runs its worktree setup, without asking. On, the first run in a repo, and the first after one of them changes, waits for you with the list: Trust and start, Run without them, or Skip (not in Full auto, which runs them unasked). It shows what a repo asks to run; it can’t tell you whether that’s safe
telemetry.privacy.pane.lede: What wisp sends about itself (never prompts, paths or code), and what it hides on screen.
telemetry.privacy.env.title: Hide .env values
telemetry.privacy.env.description: What a task shows of a .env or .env.* file reads KEY=•••• in its activity, diffs and Changes, until you press Reveal there. Not .env.example or .env.sample
